The 'gain on insurance recoveries' lines are printed as '—' for 2024 and recorded as 0. Diluted shares 18,579,691 printed in full on page 7, converted to 18,579.691 thousand; check: 4,627/18,579.691 = $0.25 FFO, 6,434/18,579.691 = $0.35 AFFO. Page 7 per-share table labels the starting line 'GAAP Net loss income' (typo in source). AFFO does not deduct recurring capex; the quarterly BRT-share recurring capex of $793,000 comes from the Capital Expenditures table on page 10 (seq 16), recorded here as 793 (thousands). Per-share reported values are consistent with the dollar totals.
